scope: Read-only review of the official Almaty municipal cadastral-map viewer and three small nearby viewports. This records source and sample metadata only; it does not establish citywide coverage or legal boundary accuracy.

viewerEvidence.finding: Loads the ArcGIS JavaScript 3.39 compact client and /uzo/lib/start.js.
Sets ArcGIS REST service root to /arcgis/rest/services.
Configures the pg_uzo MapServer and FeatureServer endpoints.
Lists U006 among guest-visible layers and configures kad_nomer as the cadastral-number search/display field; other fields are not part of this review.

layer.name: U006:Кадастр ГЗК
layer.interpretation: The municipal viewer identifies this as its GZK cadastral layer. The label and bounded samples alone do not establish complete coverage, legal status, or positional accuracy.
layer.accessNote: All sample requests were read-only HTTPS GET query/count requests. Query output was restricted to objectid and kad_nomer; no owner, subject, IIN/BIN, or other personal/ownership fields were requested or retained.

sampling.method: ArcGIS FeatureServer query using where=1=1, esriGeometryEnvelope, inSR=4326, outSR=4326, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; count-only request followed by geometry query with outFields=objectid,kad_nomer and resultRecordCount=100.
sampling.limits: Three narrowly bounded viewports near the selected center only. No citywide count, completeness check, ownership review, topology/overlap audit, or legal/accuracy assessment was performed.
